geometry.scope: Nominal coaxial spherical/plane solids, declared full OD, sampled configured-field/spectrum ray envelope and supplied scalar loss budgets.
limitations: No tilted/decentred elements, aspheres, stepped edges, flange or truncated spherical solids.
Ray coverage is the stated finite field/wavelength/pupil sampling, not a continuous-domain bound.
Mounts, spacers, insertion, bevel/support contact geometry, tooling, stress, coatings and manufacturing yield require separate evidence.
sources: Nominal radial mount reserve 0.50 mm and selected 0.05 mm geometry loss provisions.
The required meniscus API upper-thickness slot is inactive across the permitted optical track.

processAudit.scope: configured nominal coaxial solids and supplied scalar budgets; ray-envelope coverage requires audit_ray_envelope; mounting, insertion, stress, tooling, coating and manufacturing yield not evaluated

method.extrema: polynomial candidates plus sampled local refinement

processAudit.limit_precedence: Lens entries override defaults for that lens. Shared faces use the tightest effective slope/margin; air and rim requirements apply to both adjacent ambient interfaces and use the tightest complete (minimum + budget) requirement from either bordering lens. Bonded shared faces have no air/rim gap requirement.

method.geometry: analytic spherical monotonic extrema and complete cap nearest-point candidate enumeration
method.ray_envelope: Optiwork actual physical launcher and native refractive trace including exact pupil rim
